documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Management reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust pre-sales, revenue growth, and high EBITDA margins. The company added three new projects during the quarter, expanding its development pipeline to 24 projects with an aggregate gross development value of approximately INR20,000 crores. Management remains confident in achieving its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 crores and INR2,000 crores along with strong revenue and profit growth. Additionally, the company maintains a solid net cash position supported by its disciplined capital structure and efficient project execution. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited reported robust financial and operational performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, driven by strong pre-sales growth and project execution.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 pre-sales guidance ranging from INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores.
guidance.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: EBITDA and PAT margins for FY27 are expected to be 35% to 40% and 25% to 30% respectively.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining strong profitability, with EBITDA and PAT margin expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company remains confident of delivering its FY27 guidance of pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of delivering our stated guidance for FY27 of a pre-sales of INR 1,800-2,000 Crs, and revenue and PAT growth of 55-60% over FY26 levels.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to its FY27 guidance of pre-sales between INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
guidance.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA and PAT margins to be in the range of 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.
guidance.quote: We remain confident of sustaining strong profitability with EBITDA and PAT margins expected at 35% to 40% and 25% to 30%, respectively.

guidance.claim: The company intends to collect around INR1,000 crores in cash collection this financial year.
guidance.quote: So, this year we are intend to collect around INR1,000 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Housing sales in Mumbai during the first nine months of calendar 2026 reached their highest level since 2018, led by the luxury segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai remains India’s largest housing market, with sales in the first nine months of calendar 2026 at their highest since 2018, and the luxury segment continues to lead.

demand_outlook.claim: Prime residential prices in Mumbai rose by 6.2% year-on-year in the first half of the calendar year.
demand_outlook.quote: In the first half of the calendar year, sales of homes priced above INR10 crores reached a record of over INR18,500 crores, while prime residential prices rose 6.2% year-on-year, more than twice the global average.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is primarily driven by end users upgrading to larger homes in superior locations.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is driven largely by end users upgrading to larger homes in better locations, while scarce land in prime micromarkets makes redevelopment the principal route to new supply, precisely where Lotus has built its capability.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not expect the recent repo rate increase by the RBI to materially alter demand in the luxury micromarkets where they operate.
demand_outlook.quote: We, therefore, do not expect it to materially alter demand in the micromarkets we operate in.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces was observed alongside high enquiry levels for luxury residential units at the GIFT City Area project.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand from financial institutions, fintech firms, and allied sectors for Grade-A commercial spaces, coupled with differentiated project positioning and strong brand name translating into high enquiry levels for luxury residential units.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2 FY27 pre-sales grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, with six projects contributing, which shows that demand is spread across the portfolio rather than resting on a single project.

demand_outlook.claim: Luxury housing demand across Mumbai has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals.
demand_outlook.quote: Mumbai is a good example of this. Even as the overall housing market has moderated, luxury housing demand across the city has grown by more than 11%, led by successful families and professionals upgrading to bigger, better homes.

demand_outlook.claim: Supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remains constrained with very little fresh land left.
demand_outlook.quote: At the same time, supply in micro-markets like Worli, Bandra, and South Mumbai remain constrained. There is very little fresh land left, so most new luxury supply comes through redevelopment, rather than greenfield construction.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted encouraging inquiry levels across the newly launched Trident and Aquaria projects.
demand_outlook.quote: During the quarter, we launched two projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri West and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi towards the end of June 2026, and we are seeing encouraging inquiry level across both projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Three new projects were added during the quarter, adding INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: Three new projects added, Lotus Impressa at Shivaji Park in Dadar West, Lotus Stellar in Versova, and Lotus Supremus in Juhu, which adds INR2,700 to INR2,800 crores of GDV to existing GDV pipeline.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four projects with an estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores in the second half.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are well-prepared for the second half. We plan to launch four projects, Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to INR4,000 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects adding INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.
capex_expansion.quote: We also made significant progress on business development during the quarter, where company was appointed as preferred developer for three new projects: Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV.

capex_expansion.claim: Four launches are planned in H2 FY27 with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.
capex_expansion.quote: As we enter the second half, we are well prepared. Four launches are planned, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey, and Lotus Aurelia with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs.

capex_expansion.claim: The flagship ultra luxury mixed-use project in GIFT City Area has an expected commencement in Q1 FY28 and completion timeline of FY31.
capex_expansion.quote:
Completion Timeline: FY31
❖ Expected Commencement: Q1 FY28

capex_expansion.claim: During the quarter, the company launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we launched two new projects, Lotus Trident in Andheri and Lotus Aquaria in Prabhadevi, together representing a combined GDV of INR1,350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company was appointed developer for a commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.
capex_expansion.quote: We were also recently appointed developer for a very, very prestigious commercial redevelopment project with an estimated GDV of INR1,600 crores in Juhu.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we plan to launch four more projects over the remainder of FY27: Lotus Aurelia, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, and Lotus Odyssey, with a combined estimated GDV of INR3,500 to 4,000 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Total revenue for Q2 FY27 rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores, and EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores with margins expanding to 39.9%.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% year-on-year to INR269 crores. EBITDA more than doubled to INR107 crores, with margins expanding to 39.9%.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 revenue stood at INR401 crores, EBITDA at INR155 crores, and PAT at INR134 crores with a PAT margin of 33.5%.
margins_costs.quote: For the first half, revenue stood at INR401 crores, up 69%, EBITDA at INR155 crores, up 95%, and PAT at INR134 crores, up 86% at an improved PAT margin of 33.5%.

margins_costs.claim: In Q2 FY27, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.
margins_costs.quote: In Q2, total revenue rose 53% YoY to INR 269 Crs, EBITDA more than doubled to INR 107 Crs at a margin of 39.9%, and PAT grew 91% to INR 89 Crs.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores at a PAT margin of 34.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax grew 77% year-on-year to INR46 crores, at a PAT margin of 34.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4% for Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA stood at INR48 crores, growing 63% year-on-year with a healthy EBITDA margin of 36.4%.

margins_costs.claim: Average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Our average selling price stood at INR86,000 per square foot, underscoring the strength of our product across the micro-markets we operate in.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.
orders_capacity.quote: With these additions, our ongoing and upcoming pipeline now comprises 24 projects with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR20,000 crores, of which 19 are redevelopment-led.

orders_capacity.claim: Lotus Trident in Andheri West contributed pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since launch.
orders_capacity.quote: Lotus Trident in Andheri West, our luxury commercial offering, has been a standout performer, contributing pre-sales of INR178 crores in its first full quarter since its launch at the end of June.

orders_capacity.claim: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, and for H1 FY27 pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs.
orders_capacity.quote: Pre-sales for Q2 FY27 grew 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs. For H1 FY27, pre-sales stood at INR 879 Crs, up 176% YoY and on track to achieve our full-year guidance.

orders_capacity.claim: The ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Our ongoing and upcoming pipeline comprises 22 projects, 17 residential and 5 commercial, with an aggregate GDV of approximately INR17,500 to 18,000 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the 22 projects in the pipeline, 17 are redevelopment-led developments.
orders_capacity.quote: Notably, 17 of these 22 projects are redevelopment-led, reinforcing our core focus and competitive strength in this segment.

capital_allocation.claim: As of September 30, 2026, the company had a net cash position of INR494 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of 30th September 2026, we had a net cash position of INR494 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR792 crores raised through the IPO, INR305 crores had been deployed as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We raised approximately INR792 crores through the fresh issue of our IPO, with net proceeds of approximately INR732 crores after issue expenses, of which INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary for the Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun. INR305 crores had been deployed as on 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Proceeds from the fresh issue of IPO are utilized towards funding development and construction cost of ongoing projects Amalfi, The Arcadian, and Varun.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in our Subsidiaries, Richfeel Real Estate Private Limited, Dhyan Projects Private Limited and Tryksha Real Estate Private Limited for part-funding development and construction cost of our Ongoing Projects, Amalfi, The Arcadian and Varun, respectively amounting to ~INR 550 Crs.

capital_allocation.claim: As of June 2026, the company had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As of June 2026, we had a total cash balance of approximately INR776 crores against debt of INR153 crores, resulting in a net cash position of INR623 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of INR550 crores earmarked for the subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun from IPO proceeds, INR271 crores has been deployed as on 30th June 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Of the INR550 crores earmarked for our subsidiary towards Amalfi, Arcadian, and Varun, we have deployed INR271 crores as on 30th June 2026, and the utilization remains in line with our planned deployment schedule.

capital_allocation.claim: Projected free cash flow from completed and ongoing projects is approximately INR3,245 crores, while upcoming projects are expected to generate INR5,240 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Our projected free cash flow from the completed and ongoing projects at approximately INR3,245 crores, while upcoming projects are expected to generate approximately INR5,240 crores, taking the total projected surplus to approximately INR8,485 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: The RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, which is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Earlier this month, RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5%, its first increase since early 2023. While this is likely to weigh on affordable and mid-income housing, the luxury segment is far less sensitive to borrowing costs.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains confident of delivering the FY27 guidance for pre-sales, revenue, and profit growth.
management_commitments.quote: Together with the momentum from our recent launches and a growing pipeline, we remain confident of delivering our FY27 guideline of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 crores to INR2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60% over FY26 levels.

management_commitments.claim: The GIFT City Area project is expected to commence in Q1 FY28 and complete by FY31.
management_commitments.quote:
Completion Timeline: FY31
❖ Expected Commencement: Q1 FY28

management_commitments.claim: Management remains committed to the FY27 guidance of pre-sales of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores and revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by this launch pipeline, strong demand outlook, and the quality of our developments, we remain committed to our FY27 guidance of pre-sales in the range of INR1,800 to 2,000 crores, along with revenue and PAT growth of 55% to 60%.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to start the Juhu commercial redevelopment project next year and complete it in about 3 to 4 years thereafter.
management_commitments.quote: And hopefully, we will be starting this project next year, after passing of plans, and other formalities. Will take about 3 to 4 years thereafter to complete the project.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to get all approvals in place for the Gift City project by the end of the year and start the project immediately after.
management_commitments.quote: So, we are expecting that by the end of this year, we'll get all our approvals in place. Immediately after that, we will be starting the project.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the promoter equity stake of 82% will be diluted within the remaining two years out of the total three-year timeline.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have got total three years. One year has passed, so we have still two years to go. And within that time, I think we'll be able to dilute that.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
